definition_used: One or more authors objected to the notice or the wording of the notice.
caution: This reason describes an author's objection to a notice, which is a post-publication transparency signal. It does not directly indicate issues with research content, authorship, or editorial processes, so it is assigned only to the post-publication category. Main figure recommendation is false because the reason is about notice wording, not substantive manuscript problems.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes an author's objection to a notice or its wording, which is a post-publication transparency and due process signal (notice_opacity) involving the author as actor. It does not inherently imply problems with research content, attribution, or editorial governance, so only the post-publication category is assigned.
